1. Introduction

Welcome to AaloPro.

AALO PRO PTE LTD (“AaloPro”, “Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data of students, parents, teachers, educational institutions, customers and other users of our products and services.

AaloPro develops affordable artificial intelligence (AI) educational technology designed to help students learn through curriculum-aligned, personalised tutoring, including technology that can operate without a continuous internet connection.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, process, store, protect and retain personal data when you use our website, mobile applications, AI tutoring products, educational services and related platforms.

This Privacy Policy applies to:

  1. The AaloPro website at https://aalopro.com and its associated domains.
  2. AaloApp, our mobile AI tutoring application.
  3. AaloDot, our planned standalone AI tutoring device, when made available.
  4. Other AaloPro applications, software, devices and educational services.
  5. Educational pilots, school partnerships, research activities and customer support services operated by AaloPro.

All services covered by this Privacy Policy are provided by:

Company Name: AALO PRO PTE LTD

UEN: 202647042K

Registered Address: 10 BUKIT BATOK CRESCENT, #10-05B THE SPIRE, SINGAPORE 658079

Email: help@aalopro.com

Website: https://aalopro.com

We are committed to complying with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore (“PDPA”), its applicable subsidiary legislation and other applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Where our services are offered outside Singapore, we will also comply with any additional mandatory data protection laws that apply to the relevant activities.

Current availability: This policy applies to products and features when they are provided to you. Public AaloApp store links are not yet available. AaloDot is in planning, with a target to build it by early 2027; this is not a guaranteed release date. Descriptions of possible data collection, permissions, accounts or payments do not mean that every feature is currently active. We will provide the relevant information and obtain consent where required before enabling features that involve such processing.

2. Our Privacy Commitments

AaloPro is designed to make educational technology accessible, affordable and safe for students, including children in emerging markets.

We are guided by the following principles:

Privacy by Design: We seek to build privacy safeguards into our products from the beginning.

Data Minimisation: We collect only the personal data reasonably necessary to provide, maintain, secure and improve our services.

Protection of Children: We treat children's personal data as requiring enhanced care and protection.

Responsible AI: We seek to use AI responsibly, with appropriate safeguards for student information and learning interactions.

Transparency: We explain why information is collected, how it is used and when it may be shared.

User Control: We provide appropriate ways for users, parents and guardians to exercise their privacy rights.

No Sale of Student Data: We do not sell students' personal data to advertisers or data brokers.

No Targeted Advertising to Children: We do not use children's personal data or learning behaviour to deliver targeted commercial advertisements.

3. Personal Data We May Collect

The information we collect depends on the services you use, the features you activate and whether you are a student, parent, teacher, school representative or other user.

3.1 Account and Registration Information

When you register or use AaloPro services, we may collect:

  1. Name or preferred username.
  2. Mobile phone number.
  3. Email address.
  4. Country or general region.
  5. Account identifiers and authentication information.
  6. Preferred language.
  7. Parent or guardian contact information, where applicable.

We may use a one-time password (OTP) or another appropriate authentication method to verify access to an account.

3.2 Student and Educational Information

To provide relevant educational experiences, we may process:

  1. Student name, nickname or learning profile identifier.
  2. Age or age range, where necessary.
  3. School year, grade or education level.
  4. Curriculum, subjects and learning preferences.
  5. Questions submitted to the AI tutor.
  6. AI-generated educational responses.
  7. Quiz and assessment results.
  8. Learning progress, usage history and performance indicators.
  9. Feedback provided by students, teachers or parents.

We aim to collect only the information needed to support learning and do not require unnecessary personal identifiers.

3.3 Voice and Audio Information

Certain AaloPro products support voice interaction.

When a user activates a voice tutoring feature, the service may process spoken questions, voice input, speech recognition results or text transcriptions to understand the question and generate an educational response.

Depending on the product and its configuration, this processing may take place locally on the user's device.

Where a connected feature requires audio or transcribed content to be transmitted or stored, we will provide appropriate information about that processing and obtain consent where legally required.

We do not use children's voice recordings for advertising or biometric identification.

3.4 Technical and Device Information

When you use our applications, website or connected services, we may collect limited technical information such as:

  1. Device type and operating system.
  2. Application version.
  3. Device or application identifiers where necessary.
  4. IP address when connecting to online services.
  5. General diagnostic information.
  6. Error reports and application performance data.
  7. Login and security event information.
  8. Connectivity status and relevant configuration information.

Such information helps us maintain compatibility, prevent misuse, diagnose technical problems and improve our services.

3.5 Payment and Transaction Information

When you purchase a subscription, educational product or device, we may collect:

  1. Purchaser name and contact details.
  2. Order and transaction identifiers.
  3. Product or subscription purchased.
  4. Amount and currency.
  5. Payment status and transaction date.
  6. Billing or delivery details when required.
  7. Refund and customer support records.

Payments may be processed through authorised banks, mobile financial service providers, payment gateways or other payment partners.

Where payments are processed directly by these providers, payment credentials are handled in accordance with their security procedures and privacy policies.

We do not require students to provide payment card information directly to the AI tutor.

3.6 Information from Schools and Educational Partners

Where AaloPro works with schools, teachers, educational organisations or research partners, we may receive limited information necessary to administer an authorised educational programme.

This may include student identifiers, grade levels, class allocations, learning progress information or authorised institutional contact details.

We will handle such information according to applicable law, the relevant educational arrangement and any required consent or authorisation.

4. How We Collect Personal Data

We may collect personal data when you:

  1. Register for an account or create a student learning profile.
  2. Use AaloApp, AaloDot or another AaloPro product.
  3. Submit questions, complete lessons or participate in assessments.
  4. Purchase subscriptions or devices.
  5. Contact customer support.
  6. Participate in an authorised school pilot or educational programme.
  7. Subscribe to communications or participate in surveys.
  8. Visit our website or use online features that collect necessary technical information.

We may also receive information from parents, guardians, schools, educational partners or authorised service providers, where permitted by law.

5. How We Use Personal Data

AaloPro may collect, use and process personal data for the following purposes.

5.1 Providing Educational Services

To create and manage accounts, deliver curriculum-aligned lessons, generate AI tutoring responses, maintain learning sessions and provide educational features requested by users.

5.2 Personalising Learning

To adapt educational content, difficulty levels, language preferences and learning activities to the relevant student's needs, where such processing is supported by the product.

5.3 Tracking Learning Progress

To provide appropriate learning feedback, track educational progress and support learning reports for authorised users, parents, guardians or educational institutions.

5.4 Managing Payments and Orders

To process purchases, manage subscriptions, confirm payments, provide receipts, deliver products and administer refunds.

5.5 Maintaining Security and Reliability

To protect accounts, investigate suspicious activity, prevent fraud, resolve technical issues and maintain system availability.

5.6 Improving Our Services

To identify product issues, evaluate performance, improve educational quality and understand general product usage.

Where possible, we use aggregated or appropriately de-identified information for product analysis.

5.7 Communicating with Users

To respond to enquiries, provide technical support, send essential service notifications and inform users of important account, payment, security or privacy changes.

5.8 Meeting Legal Obligations

To comply with applicable laws, lawful regulatory requests, legal proceedings and other requirements imposed by competent authorities.

We do not use personal data for purposes materially different from those notified without providing further notice and obtaining additional consent where required.

6. Consent and Appropriate Data Processing

Where consent is required under Singapore's PDPA or other applicable laws, AaloPro will obtain appropriate consent before collecting, using or disclosing personal data.

Consent may be provided through account registration, authorised parental or guardian approval, optional feature activation or other appropriate consent mechanisms.

In circumstances permitted by law, personal data may also be processed under applicable statutory exceptions to consent.

We will not require users to consent to unnecessary data collection as a condition of receiving our core educational services.

Users may withdraw consent by contacting us, subject to applicable legal requirements and reasonable notice.

Withdrawal of consent may affect our ability to provide certain features that depend on the relevant information. We will explain any relevant consequences before implementing a withdrawal request.

7. Children's Privacy and Parental Consent

Protecting children's personal data is a fundamental part of AaloPro's approach to educational technology.

Many AaloPro users are primary and secondary school students. We therefore apply additional safeguards when handling children's information.

7.1 Children Below 13 Years of Age

Where a child is below 13 years of age, AaloPro requires consent from a parent or legal guardian before collecting, using or disclosing the child's personal data where consent is required.

Parents or guardians should be informed about the relevant data collection purposes and the educational features their children will use.

We will implement appropriate consent and authorisation procedures before enabling features requiring such consent.

7.2 Students Aged 13 to 17

For students aged 13 to 17, consent may be obtained in accordance with applicable law, taking into account the child's ability to understand how personal information is collected, used and disclosed.

Where parental or guardian consent is required by applicable law, the educational arrangement or the circumstances of the student, we will obtain that consent.

We encourage parents and guardians to remain involved in their children's use of AI educational services.

7.3 Special Safeguards for Children

AaloPro is committed to the following practices:

  1. Collecting only personal information reasonably necessary for educational purposes.
  2. Avoiding unnecessary collection of national identification numbers, passport information or other highly sensitive identifiers.
  3. Keeping children's learning profiles private by default.
  4. Not selling children's personal data.
  5. Not using student learning behaviour for targeted commercial advertising.
  6. Not making student learning histories publicly searchable.
  7. Limiting access to student information to appropriately authorised parties.
  8. Avoiding collection of precise location information unless genuinely necessary for a disclosed purpose.
  9. Providing appropriate mechanisms for parents and guardians to raise privacy concerns.

7.4 Parents' and Guardians' Rights

Subject to applicable law, verification and relevant educational arrangements, parents and legal guardians may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their children's personal data.

They may also request information about how their children's data is being used or withdraw consent where they are authorised to do so.

Requests can be submitted to help@aalopro.com.

8. Offline AI Processing and Learning Privacy

AaloPro develops AI tutoring technology intended to operate locally on compatible devices.

For features specifically provided as offline AI tutoring, educational processing is designed to occur on the relevant device without requiring a continuous internet connection for every tutoring interaction.

The information processed locally may include:

  1. Questions submitted by students.
  2. Spoken instructions or their transcriptions.
  3. Curriculum materials and educational content.
  4. AI-generated responses.
  5. Locally maintained learning context or preferences.

Information processed solely on a user's device is not automatically accessible to AaloPro simply because the user operates the offline tutoring feature.

However, some services may require an internet connection, including account authentication, subscription validation, payments, software updates, customer support and optional connected features.

Where relevant, the application may also communicate with authorised services for diagnostic, security or account management purposes.

The precise information transmitted depends on the features used and their configuration.

We aim to minimise the transmission of student learning content and clearly distinguish local processing from connected services.

9. Artificial Intelligence, Learning Data and Model Development

AaloPro uses AI technology to understand educational questions, generate explanations, provide learning assistance and support curriculum-aligned learning.

AI systems may generate responses based on the information a student provides during a learning session.

We recognise that students may sometimes include personal information in their questions.

AaloPro therefore seeks to minimise unnecessary collection and retention of personal information contained in tutoring interactions.

We do not use identifiable children's private learning conversations or raw voice recordings for general AI model training without providing specific notice and obtaining any consent required by law.

Where personal data is proposed to be used for AI model development, training or fine-tuning, we will assess the purpose, necessity, applicable legal requirements and appropriate safeguards.

General notices stating that information may be used to improve services will not be treated as sufficient consent for materially different AI training activities where specific notification and consent are required.

We may use properly anonymised or aggregated information to evaluate educational outcomes, understand general usage patterns and improve product quality.

AI-generated educational responses may occasionally be inaccurate. Users should verify important information and should not enter passwords, identification documents, financial credentials or other unnecessary sensitive details into the AI tutor.

10. Application Permissions

Certain AaloPro features may request permission to access specific device capabilities.

Microphone: Used when voice tutoring or voice input features are activated.

Bluetooth or Nearby Devices: Used where supported to communicate with compatible AaloPro educational hardware or accessories.

Local Storage: Used where necessary to store application files, curriculum content, downloaded learning materials or local learning information.

Notifications: Used to provide relevant account, educational or service information where enabled.

Permissions are requested according to the functions available in the relevant application.

Users may manage certain permissions through their device settings.

Disabling a permission may prevent the associated feature from working.

We do not seek access to unrelated device information without a legitimate and disclosed purpose.

11. Cookies and Website Analytics

About this website: Our public website currently provides product information and email enquiry links. It does not offer account registration, student-profile forms or a payment checkout. If you email us, we process the information you choose to send so that we can respond. Hosting and security services may process technical request information, as described in this policy. Data processing by an AaloPro application or an educational programme depends on the particular service and features used.

Optional Google Analytics

If you accept analytics, our public website uses Google Analytics 4, provided by Google, to understand website visits and engagement. This may include pages visited, referral sources, approximate location, browser and device information, product-link clicks, email-enquiry link clicks and video activity. An email-link click does not tell us whether an email was sent, and a product-link click is not an app installation.

Google Analytics may store cookies containing pseudonymous browser identifiers. We configure the website's analytics cookies, including _ga and _ga_YYPTQER95H, with a lifetime of up to 180 days. These identifiers are not the same as anonymous data. Google states that Google Analytics 4 does not log or store IP addresses, although it uses them to derive approximate location during collection.

Your choice and withdrawal

The Google Analytics tag is blocked until you select Accept analytics. If you select Reject analytics, the tag does not load. Rejecting optional analytics does not restrict access to our pages, product information or videos.

You can reopen Cookie settings in any page footer to change your choice. Withdrawing consent stops future collection by this website and removes its accessible Google Analytics cookies. It does not automatically delete information already collected; contact help@aalopro.com about privacy or deletion requests.

We store your acceptance or rejection in your browser's local storage for up to 180 days so that we can remember your preference. This preference record contains the choice and its expiry time, not a visitor identifier. Clearing browser storage may cause us to ask again. If browser storage is unavailable, your choice applies to the current page.

Limits and service providers

Before loading analytics, we remove URL query parameters and unrecognised fragments from the browser address to avoid collecting unexpected information in links. Our website's custom analytics events use product and action labels. We do not intentionally send student names, email addresses, learning conversations or voice recordings to website analytics. We disable Google Signals and advertising personalisation signals in this website's tag configuration. AaloPro does not use children's learning data to serve behavioural or targeted advertisements.

Google processes analytics information to provide measurement services and may process it outside Singapore, subject to the safeguards described in this policy and applicable agreements. Analytics data retention is governed by the settings in our Google Analytics property. For information about Google's handling of data, see Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from partner sites.

12. Payments and Third-Party Payment Providers

AaloPro may engage authorised payment service providers, banks and mobile financial service providers to process purchases and subscriptions.

Depending on the user's country and available payment options, such providers may include local payment gateways, mobile wallets, card processors or banking partners.

These providers may collect and process payment information under their own privacy notices and applicable financial services regulations.

AaloPro may receive transaction references, payment confirmation details, billing information and other limited records reasonably necessary to administer purchases and resolve payment enquiries.

We do not sell users' financial information.

Where a third-party processes a payment, users should also review that provider's privacy policy.

13. Disclosure of Personal Data to Third Parties

AaloPro does not sell or trade personal data to unrelated third parties for their independent commercial advertising purposes.

We may disclose limited personal data to third parties where reasonably necessary and legally permitted.

These may include:

Technology and Hosting Providers: Providers supporting authorised infrastructure, account services, hosting, application maintenance or security.

Payment Providers: Banks, payment gateways and financial service partners processing transactions.

Educational Partners: Schools, teachers and educational organisations authorised to administer relevant programmes or receive appropriate learning information.

Delivery and Fulfilment Providers: Service providers handling product delivery, where applicable.

Professional Advisers: Legal, accounting, audit or other professional advisers acting under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.

Regulatory and Public Authorities: Competent authorities where disclosure is required or permitted by applicable law.

Business Successors: Parties involved in a legitimate merger, acquisition or business restructuring, subject to appropriate safeguards and applicable legal requirements.

Where third parties process personal data on our behalf, we will implement appropriate contractual and organisational safeguards consistent with applicable law.

Third parties will not be authorised to use personal data for unrelated purposes merely because they provide services to AaloPro.

14. International Transfer of Personal Data

AaloPro is incorporated in Singapore and may provide services to users in other countries.

Certain operational activities, authorised educational programmes, technical support arrangements or service providers may involve the processing or transfer of personal data across national borders.

Where personal data is transferred outside Singapore, AaloPro will comply with the Transfer Limitation Obligation under the PDPA and applicable regulations.

We will take appropriate steps to ensure that overseas recipients provide a standard of protection comparable to that required under Singapore law, unless a lawful exception applies.

Such steps may include contractual commitments, appropriate due diligence, technical safeguards and other legally recognised transfer mechanisms.

Where additional local laws apply, we will assess and comply with relevant requirements.

15. Data Storage and Retention

AaloPro retains personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected or to meet legitimate legal or business requirements.

Retention periods may vary according to the type of information and its purpose.

Account information may be retained while an account remains active and for a necessary period following closure.

Educational records may be maintained where necessary to deliver learning features, provide authorised progress reports or administer an educational programme.

Transaction and accounting records may be retained for the periods required by applicable laws.

Security logs and technical information will be retained according to their operational necessity and relevant retention schedules.

Where personal data is no longer necessary for legal or business purposes, we will cease retaining it or remove the means by which it can be associated with an identifiable individual, in accordance with applicable law.

Information stored locally on a user's device may remain there until removed by the user, application functionality or device management processes.

Deleting an application may not automatically delete personal data held in connected systems. Users should contact us where they wish to request deletion of relevant account information.

16. Security and Protection of Personal Data

We take reasonable administrative, technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, collection, use, disclosure, modification, copying, disposal and other similar risks.

Depending on the system, these measures may include:

  1. Appropriate access controls and authentication procedures.
  2. Encryption for relevant information in transit and at rest.
  3. Secure software development practices.
  4. System monitoring and vulnerability management.
  5. Restrictions on employee and service provider access.
  6. Appropriate confidentiality obligations.
  7. Security incident response procedures.
  8. Periodic review of data protection practices.

We apply additional care when handling information relating to children.

No technology or system can guarantee absolute security. However, we are committed to implementing and maintaining safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information we process.

Where a data breach occurs, we will assess and manage the incident and notify the Personal Data Protection Commission of Singapore and affected individuals where required by applicable law.

17. Access, Correction, Withdrawal of Consent and Deletion

Subject to applicable law, users may have the right to:

Request Access: Ask for personal data held by AaloPro and information about its use or disclosure, as provided for under applicable law.

Request Correction: Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent previously provided for relevant collection, use or disclosure activities, subject to applicable requirements.

Request Deletion: Request deletion of personal data where appropriate, subject to legal retention obligations and other applicable limitations.

Raise a Concern: Contact us regarding the handling or protection of personal information.

Requests should be sent to help@aalopro.com.

To protect personal data, we may request reasonable information to verify the identity or authority of the person making the request.

We will review requests and respond within the timeframes required by applicable law. We will explain any applicable limitations, consequences or permitted fees where relevant.

18. Marketing and Service Communications

AaloPro may communicate with users regarding account activities, subscriptions, educational services, product updates, customer support and other matters necessary to provide our services.

We may separately offer adults the opportunity to receive information about new products, educational services, events or promotional offers.

Where consent is legally required for marketing communications, we will obtain that consent.

Users may unsubscribe from optional marketing messages through available unsubscribe mechanisms or by contacting us.

We will respect applicable requirements under Singapore's PDPA, including the Do Not Call provisions where relevant.

We do not use children's personal data for targeted commercial marketing.

Unsubscribing from marketing communications does not prevent us from sending essential account, security or transactional notices.

19. Educational Institutions, Teachers and Pilot Programmes

AaloPro may cooperate with schools, teachers, educational institutions, nonprofit organisations and research partners to conduct educational pilots or provide learning technology.

Where these activities involve personal data, we will determine the relevant responsibilities for collection, use, disclosure, security and retention through appropriate notices, permissions and contractual arrangements.

Student information obtained through educational programmes will be used for the authorised educational purposes and other purposes properly notified and permitted under applicable law.

Any sharing of identifiable student progress or performance information will be limited to appropriately authorised persons.

Where school, teacher or research reports do not require student identification, we will seek to use aggregated or anonymised information.

Student photographs, recordings, identifiable testimonials or individual educational results will not be publicly published for promotional purposes without the necessary permission or consent.

20. Third-Party Websites and Services

Our website or applications may contain links to external websites, applications, payment services or educational resources.

These third-party services may operate under their own privacy policies and terms.

AaloPro is not responsible for the independent privacy practices of third parties that we do not control.

We encourage users and parents to review the privacy notices of external services before sharing personal data.

21. Changes to This Privacy Policy

AaloPro may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our products, services, technology, data protection practices or applicable legal requirements.

When we make changes, we will update the effective date or last updated date shown at the beginning of this Privacy Policy.

Where changes materially affect how personal data is collected, used or disclosed, we will provide additional notice and obtain consent where required by law.

The current version of this Privacy Policy will be made available through our website.

22. Governing Law

This Privacy Policy is intended to operate in accordance with the applicable laws of Singapore, including the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 and its subsidiary legislation.

Nothing in this Privacy Policy limits or excludes any rights, protections or obligations that cannot lawfully be limited or excluded.

Where mandatory privacy or data protection requirements in another jurisdiction apply to our services or users, those requirements will also be observed.

24. A Simple Privacy Explanation for Students

Your learning is personal, and we want to keep it safe.

When you use AaloPro, you can ask questions, practise lessons and learn new things with AI.

Here are some important things to know.

  1. We use information about your lessons to help provide your learning experience.
  2. We do not sell your personal information to advertisers.
  3. We do not use your learning activity to show you targeted advertisements.
  4. Some AaloPro learning features work offline on your device.
  5. You should not tell the AI tutor your password, home address or other private information that it does not need.
  6. If you are younger than 13, your parent or guardian must give the required permission before we collect or use your personal information.
  7. If you are worried about your privacy, you can ask a parent, guardian or teacher to help you contact us.

Need help?

Email us at help@aalopro.com.

We want AI learning to be useful, accessible and safe for every student.
